item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00213","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C07","C14","C02"],"selected_candidate_label":"C07","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C07 is a strong reusable template: both proclamations recite a statute that suspends a tax or duty until a specified factual condition is officially found, recount the required finding or report, and then proclaim termination or revocation of the suspension with a defined effective date. They also share concrete customs language concerning articles entered for consumption or withdrawn from warehouse. C14 has related tariff-adjustment and Tariff Commission machinery, while C02 has a similar termination-proclamation form, but neither matches the child's conditional suspension-revocation structure as closely as C07.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the President shall, by proclamation ... revoke such suspension of the duties","parent_excerpt":"the provisions of section 2470(a)(2) ... shall be suspended until the expiration of 30 days after he proclaims that ... such adequate supplies are so readily available","explanation":"Both quote statutory machinery requiring a later presidential proclamation, triggered by an official factual condition, to end a previously operative suspension."},{"child_excerpt":"the Tariff Commission reported to me that it has found that the average market price ... has been below 18 cents per pound","parent_excerpt":"I have consulted with the President of the Philippines ... and have found that such adequate supplies are now readily available","explanation":"Each recital records completion of the prescribed fact-finding predicate immediately before the operative proclamation."},{"child_excerpt":"do hereby proclaim the revocation of the suspension of duties","parent_excerpt":"do hereby proclaim that ... the suspension of the provisions ... will be terminated","explanation":"The operative clauses use materially parallel language to end a statutory tax or duty suspension."},{"child_excerpt":"effective with respect to articles entered for consumption or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption after the date of this proclamation","parent_excerpt":"on and after August 27, 1949, the processing tax provided for in that section will be applicable","explanation":"Both specify when the restored fiscal burden becomes applicable after proclamation, with the child adapting the parent structure to customs-entry terminology."}]}
